readmeHtml:
This version of OrcaSlicer restores full BambuNetwork support for Bambu Lab printers.

You are not limited to LAN only.
It works over the internet just like before, through BambuNetwork, with full functionality for normal use and printing.

Installation

Windows

Windows requires WSL 2.

Before first launch, open Command Prompt or PowerShell as Administrator and run:

dism.exe /online /enable-feature /featurename:Microsoft-Windows-Subsystem-Linux /all /norestart
dism.exe /online /enable-feature /featurename:VirtualMachinePlatform /all /norestart

Restart Windows, then launch Orca Studio.

Linux

On Linux, a normal installation is enough.

macOS

Work in progress.

BMCU

I also encourage you to use BMCU.

You can find BMCU firmware in my repositories.

aiSummary.oneLiner: An advanced, open-source 3D printing slicer optimized for Bambu Lab printers.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: OrcaSlicer is a highly optimized fork of popular 3D printing slicing software, specifically tailored to maximize the capabilities of Bambu Lab 3D printers. It processes 3D models (STL, OBJ, etc.) and translates them into precise G-code instructions for the printer. The software implements advanced path planning algorithms, intelligent support generation, and specific profiles tuned for Bambu Lab's high-speed kinematics. By offering deeper parameter control and integrated calibration tools, it allows users to push their hardware beyond the constraints of standard proprietary slicers, achieving higher print quality and reliability.
keyFeatures: Bambu Lab Optimization: Custom kinematic profiles and machine limits tuned specifically for Bambu Lab hardware.
Advanced Path Planning: Employs sophisticated algorithms to optimize travel moves and reduce print time.
Integrated Calibration Suite: Features built-in tools for tuning flow rate, pressure advance, and temperature towers.
Customizable Support Structures: Offers fine-grained control over support generation for complex overhangs.
Multi-Material Management: Seamlessly handles multi-color and multi-material prints via the AMS system.

useCases.title: Precision Calibration

useCases.title: Complex Geometry Fabrication

useCases.title: Open-Source Alternative

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Aimed at 3D printing enthusiasts, makers, and engineers who own Bambu Lab printers and demand advanced control over their slicing parameters. A basic understanding of 3D printing concepts is recommended.
aiSummary.gettingStarted: Download the latest release for your operating system from the GitHub releases page and run the executable.
